name: DescribeVpcs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC. 

You can specify up to 20 VPC IDs. Separate multiple VPC IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
VPC的ID。 

最多支持指定20个VPC ID，多个VPC的ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the default VPC in the specified region. Valid values: 

true (default): Queries the default VPC in the specified region.  

false: Does not query the default VPC
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询指定地域下的默认VPC，取值： 

true（默认值）：查询指定地域下的默认VPC。  

false：不查询默认VPC。
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including invalid AccessKey pairs, unauthorized Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and missing parameter values. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a Normal request, and the resource status is directly queried after the request passes the authorization check. An HTTP 2xx status code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接查询资源状况
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the VPC belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的VPC所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging queries. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID that owns the VPC
parameters.name: vpc_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DHCP options set
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query VPCs that have IPv6 CIDR blocks enabled in the specified region. The default value is empty, which means no filtering is performed based on IPv6 enablement. Valid values:

false: IPv6 is not enabled.
true: IPv6 is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询指定地域下开启IPv6网段的VPC，默认为空值（空值则不根据是否开启IPv6网段做过滤），取值：

false：不开启。
true：开启
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

Ipv6Isp.description_en:
The type of the IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC. Valid values:

BGP: Alibaba Cloud BGP IPv6.
ChinaMobile: China Mobile (single-ISP).
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom (single-ISP).
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom (single-ISP).

If you are a user who has the single-ISP bandwidth whitelist enabled, this field can be set to ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), ChinaUnicom (China Unicom), or ChinaMobile (China Mobile)

ChinaTelecom：中国电信（单线）。
